						EXPECTED_STATE = 1
					}

					has_variable = zg361_cp_player_batch_mode
					var:zg361_cp_player_batch_mode >= 1
					var:zg361_cp_player_batch_mode <= 3
				}

				zg361_cp_clear_pending_player_event_effect = { EVENT = 9331 }

				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_cp_r_subject = { var:zg361_cp_player_batch_mode = 2 } }
